notes: «هو ابن عمرو الرقي» after «عبيد الله» is an editor's identification gloss, left out
«كان سعد يعلم بنيه» describes an action, but «ويقول إن رسول الله ... كان يتعوذ» gives his words, so Sa'd is the last link (rule 6)
The commentary «قال عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن» (Darimi) and «قال أبو عيسى» (Tirmidhi) is commentary, not a link; the second group is the commentary's variant naming Abu Ishaq with Umar
Occurrence 3 for «عمر» counts the «عمرو» forms before it; the reading should be checked by the tool
